TransactionSecurityPolicy.customEmailContent:
Salesforce Security Alert – High API Anomaly Detected


Salesforce Threat Detection has identified unusual API activity that significantly differs from the user's normal behavior.


Policy: {{policy.MasterLabel}}

Organization ID: {{policy.OrganizationId}}

User: {{event.Username}}

Event Date: {{event.EventDate}}

Anomaly Score: {{event.Score}}

Operation: {{event.Operation}}

Queried Entities: {{event.QueriedEntities}}

Rows Processed: {{event.RowsProcessed}}

Source IP: {{event.SourceIp}}

User Agent: {{event.UserAgent}}


This alert may indicate unusual query volume, data access patterns, or API usage.


No API request has been automatically blocked by this policy.


Please review the corresponding API Anomaly Event in Salesforce Event Monitoring to confirm whether the activity is expected and legitimate.


Salesforce Security Monitoring
TransactionSecurityPolicy.description: Detects high-risk anomalies in Salesforce API activity identified by Threat Detection. The policy alerts the Security team when API usage significantly differs from the user's usual behavior, including unusual query volumes, data access patterns or API activity. Monitoring only – no blocking action.
